signature.name: Coffee-Ritual Specificity (the swap test)
signature.description: Does the motion depict a real, specific moment of making coffee with material-true physics, so that swapping the coffee art for a generic shape would break the idea?

bare-wire.signature_why: Crema on a top-down espresso is genuinely of the category, but the 'heal' disc grows outward behind the scar so it plays as an expanding ring every second - swap the cup for a circle and it is a sonar ping, not crema closing in on itself.
bare-wire.loved: Real restraint: six shapes, fills only, one container-sized component, and a crema field that breathes on a slow 5s second clock.
bare-wire.docked: Pitch sells it as 'the inverse of a ripple' while the code (scar .05->.8, heal .03->.8 a beat later) draws exactly a ripple, at a busy 1Hz that reads as a pulse at 120px.

warm-hands.signature_why: A pour, a hand-wobbled rim and a mug-ring stain taste of a real cafe, but the cream spiral rotates as a rigid decal - poured milk never spins as a finished shape, so the motion is a spinner wearing latte art.
warm-hands.loved: The most ownable brand world on the table: imperfect rim, thumb smudge, ring stain, sienna pour tip, and a calm one-turn-per-5s wrist sway that loops with no seam.
warm-hands.docked: Rigid rotation is the physics of a progress spinner, not liquid; to their credit the pitch names the cinnamon-roll/spinner risk and the per-frame SVG repaint honestly.

the-glitch.signature_why: A drop falling from a spout with proper gravity easing is a nod to the shot, but one bead per second is a leaky tap, and the pip chaser and mis-registered band would sit unchanged on any banking app.
the-glitch.loved: The falling drop itself - swell at the spout, ease-in fall, flat ring on the surface - is the one honestly observed coffee gesture here.
the-glitch.docked: A deliberate 'hiccup' and hopping safety-orange pips are UI conceits with no coffee in them; a stripe on the outside of the cup is not crema, and the glitch spends the brand's one waiting moment looking broken.
